data.name: Kalebiel
data.gender_notes: Kalebiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Kalebiel is derived from the Hebrew words 'kal' (great) and 'el' (God). Thus, Kalebiel means 'God is my strength'. In the Bible, there is a character named Kaleb who was a loyal and faithful follower of Moses, who helped lead the Israelites into the Promised Land. This name signifies strength in God and loyalty to one's faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies reliance on God's strength and protection.
data.etymology: Kalebiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kalebiel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קאליביאל
in_hebrew.meaning: קאליביאל - מלאך אלוהים, כוחו של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קאליביאל הוא שם עברי שמורכב משני שמות עבריים: קאל, שפירושו 'כל' או 'כולו', ו-אל, שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם קאליביאל מתפרש כ'מלאך אלוהים' או 'כוחו של אלוהים'. הוא נמצא בשימוש במסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד, ומייצג את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Καληβίηλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Καληβίηλ είναι όνομα ελληνικό που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: Καλ, που σημαίνει 'όλος' ή 'κάθε', και -ελ, που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Το Καληβίηλ σημαίνει 'δυνάμει Θεοῦ' ή 'άγγελος Θεοῦ'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη σχέση μεταξύ του ανθρώπου και του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Kalebiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kalebiel originem habet hebraicam. Compositum est ex duobus nominibus hebraicis: Cal, quod significat 'totus' vel 'omnis', et -el, quod significat 'Deus'. Kalebiel interpretatur 'Potentia Dei' vel 'angelus Dei'. In traditione christiana, hoc nomen significat connexionem inter hominem et Deum.

in_english.name: Kalebiel
in_english.meaning: Kalebiel - Angel of God or Power of God
in_english.long_meaning: Kalebiel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots. It is composed of two Hebrew words: Cal, meaning 'all' or 'every', and -el, meaning 'God'. The name Kalebiel translates to 'Angel of God' or 'Power of God'. In Christian tradition, this name represents the connection between humans and God, symbolizing divine strength and protection. Historically, the name has been used in Jewish and Christian communities, reflecting its biblical and spiritual significance.

This belief has been passed down through generations and is an important part of the Jewish and Christian literary and spiritual traditions.
